summary: RFC 5444 defines a generalized packet and message format for mobile ad hoc network routing protocols. This document updates it with rules and recommendations for designing new protocols that use the format, so multiple protocols can share it without conflicts.

eli5.summary: If many people use the same shared form, they need rules for how to fill it in so they do not mess up each other's entries.

questions: how to design a protocol using rfc 5444
